description: This file contains functions for setting up and managing DRM/KMS components such as encoders, connectors, CRTCs, and planes, including resource acquisition and cleanup.

methods.name: kms_setup_encoder
methods.description: Initializes the encoder for the given DRM file descriptor and kms context, selecting an encoder that matches the connector or possible CRTCs.

methods.name: kms_setup_connector
methods.description: Finds and sets the active connector that is connected and has available modes.

methods.name: kms_setup_crtc
methods.description: Sets up the CRTC based on the encoder's CRTC ID and current mode.

methods.name: kms_setup
methods.description: Allocates and initializes the kms_ctx structure, setting up connector, encoder, and CRTC.

methods.name: kms_cleanup_context
methods.description: Frees resources associated with the kms_ctx structure.

methods.name: kms_get_properties
methods.description: Retrieves the property ID for a given property name on a DRM object.

methods.name: kms_get_plane
methods.description: Retrieves primary and overlay plane IDs by querying available planes and their properties.
